before_you_start: Turn spoiler protection on before your first session and leave it on until the story is finished; it hides unearned story trophies in this guide. No difficulty setting affects trophies in this list, because the official list contains no difficulty trophy, so choose the difficulty you enjoy. Plan for one thorough playthrough with chapter-select unknown: because no chapter replay feature is confirmed by the official list, treat chapter-boundary manual saves as your replay system and keep them separate. These are planning notes based on the official list, not promises about unconfirmed game features.
difficulty: Estimated 4/10, estimated 80-120 hours for the platinum. This is an editorial estimate, clearly labelled as an estimate, based on GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 trophy-design precedent: the official list contains no difficulty trophy, one 100 percent completion gold, and several long counters such as 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK locations and 500 tracked choice actions. Nothing in the list demands perfect play on a hard mode, so time and thoroughness, not reflex difficulty, are the main cost.
missables_strategy: Keep a manual save before each chapter's end and never rely on a single autosave. Never overwrite your only save after a strand's final mission becomes available; save in a fresh slot before every strand finale instead. Do the partner trophies while your partner is around in free roam, not as a post-game afterthought. Check the Missables view before finishing the final mission, and only start the finale when every missable you care about is earned or safely parked in a save you can return to.
online_split: All 55 trophies in this official list are offline and single-player. No trophy in the list describes online play, multiplayer modes, co-op servers or competitive play, so the platinum needs no online play at all. If future DLC adds a separate trophy list, that list would be separate from these 55 and is not covered here.

stages.detail: Play the chapters, the named missions and the final mission in order, with spoiler protection on and a manual save at every chapter boundary. Do not grind activities or collectibles yet, because story progress opens the map, systems and strands that everything else depends on. Keep a separate save before the final mission and never overwrite it with your only post-game save.
stages.goal: Finish the main story once, cleanly, with good save habits.
stages.title: Story first
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.detail: Work through Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone to their final missions, plus enough other stranger strands to complete eight in total for Strangers & Freaks. Save in a separate slot before every strand final and check this stage before you finish the main story finale. Bret's unique-animal hunt also belongs to this side-story sweep.
stages.goal: Complete every named strand final and reach 8 completed stranger strands.
stages.title: Strands & side stories

stages.detail: This is the longest stage: shooting range golds, 250 stunts, races and drone races, fishing, arcade, meditation spots and full exploration of Leonida all feed A Long Road. Sample every activity type once for Master of None, then settle into focused batches per activity family. Sweep the map region by region so exploration, meditation and stunts advance together instead of in separate trips.
stages.goal: Drive completion to 100 percent through activities and exploration.
stages.title: The 100% push

stages.detail: Complete three full card sets one set at a time, reach 100 WAiNK locations, discover 100 vehicles and register 10 of them to Scooter Bros, and push challenges to 50 completions. The tracked choice count behind Actions Speak Louder also belongs to this stage, so keep taking choice prompts and check its progress here. Counters reward steady bookkeeping, so use the Guide filters to see exactly what remains.
stages.goal: Finish the set-based collectibles and the long counters.
stages.title: Collectibles & counters

stages.detail: Rob bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store undetected and one illegal operation per gang, while laundering marked bills toward 250,000 dollars. Spend across shops toward 100,000 dollars and buy all eight garage properties as districts open. Keep the money cycle regular rather than stockpiling, and escape cleanly after every robbery so it counts.
stages.goal: Run the crime and money systems until their totals land.
stages.title: Money & property

stages.detail: Hunt the cryptic trophies with their inference-labelled guidance, finish partner trophies if they are still open, and pick off single-moment trophies such as the Ocean Beach cocktail, the showroom exit, bowling and the melee drive-by. Use the Missables view for a final audit before you call the list done. When the other 54 are earned, Vice Got a Price! unlocks and the platinum is yours.
stages.goal: Clear hidden and one-off trophies, then take the platinum.
stages.title: Cleanup & platinum
